text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, camera is good to go! Now 
starting the 'Presence Slash' challenge!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll just track the beep-beep-beep of the 
alarm clock by sound alone and smack it 
right on the top!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now then, close your eyes~ spin, spin, 
spin~~... —Right here! Hyah!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Aah!? Chrono-chan's book...! A-Anyway, 
I've gotta fix it...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...H-How were they lined up again...!? 
Aaaah, I'm so sorry, Chrono-chaaaan!!"
